clinician.summary: Female patient right eye visual acuity 6/6. Left eye visual acuity 6/12. Intraocular pressures 15 mmHg bilaterally. Fundoscopy: moderate non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy (R2) with macular oedema (M1), no proliferative changes (P0). Intravitreal anti-VEGF injection given today. Follow-up in 4 weeks for repeat treatment as required

patient.summary: female patient attended the hospital and had an examination and treatment for haemorrhoids. This included removing some abnormal skin tags and injecting the haemorrhoids to help shrink them. The patient was given instructions on how to care for themselves after the procedure, such as avoiding straining and increasing fluid intake. The patient will have a telephone appointment with the doctor in 6 weeks to check how they are recovering
